summary: Describes an information model for Kerberos version 5 from the standpoint of an administrative service. Since there is no standard for administering a Key Distribution Center, it describes what services an administrative interface to one exposes.

eli5.summary: A list of the jobs the manager of a ticket office needs to do, such as adding people and fixing accounts, written so anyone can build a control panel.

questions: how to administer a kerberos kdc
what is the kerberos information model
